title: Experiments: best combinations to start with
intro: The list holds 27 combinations in groups: Irrigation, Nitrogen, Climate, Soil and crop, Chemicals and Parameters. Each shows the topics of the reference it draws on. Choosing one shows why it is worth running; the tick boxes select several to add at once.

marks.d: Ticks the combination so that several can be added together.
A combination with the topics of the Daisy reference it draws on.
Loads the plan of the chosen combination for checking and running.
Adds the chosen combination to the list of experiments without loading it.
Adds every ticked combination, each as an experiment of its own.
